title.value: Il Signore dei Demoni urla a Sasazuka

overview.value: Maou and company face their usual budget crisis while Emi and Suzuno attempt to have a conversation next door. It's the same old, same old... except that today, they sense an ominous presence. Before long, a bloodcurdling scream will rend the night.

title.value: Incredibile! Il Signore dei Demoni e l'Eroe diventano genitori

overview.value: Alas Ramus seems dead set on the idea that Maou and Emi are her parents. After a few attempts at babysitting by Maou and Ashiya, though, it's clear that Chiho is the only one ready to cope with the realities of parenting. Her boss at MgRonald's isn't thrilled about all of this, but Chiho may have a future in the Devil's army.

title.value: Come suggerito, il Signore dei Demoni e l'Eroe vanno al parco divertimenti

overview.value: Maou, Emi, and Alas Ramus have an eventful day at the amusement park. Meanwhile, their three stalkers do their not-so-great best to blend in.

title.value: Il Signore dei Demoni impara cosa vuol dire perdere qualcosa di prezioso

overview.value: Emi attends a sleepover at the Devil's Castle. But in the morning, the fight for Alas Ramus and the sacred sword begins. Will Maou and Emi win? Will Gabriel take what's precious? Will there be a magical girl transformation sequence?!

title.value: Il Signore dei Demoni va al mare dopo aver perso casa e lavoro

overview.value: Alas Ramus may be safe, but Maou and his roommates have a few more crises to face. Luckily, they have strong allies on their side.

title.value: L'Eroe aiuta il Signore dei Demoni sul posto di lavoro

overview.value: With Ohguro's new and improved look, business is booming! In fact, there are more customers than Maou and his team can handle alone. And at night, there are ominous shadows in the fog...

title.value: Il Signore dei Demoni apprende che Choshi e il mondo sono più grandi di quel che pensava

overview.value: Emi, Maou, and the gang learn the source of the recent demon invasion, as well as some surprising facts about Choshi City and their boss.

title.value: Il Signore dei Demoni si dà all'agricoltura

overview.value: Maou, Ashiya, and Urushihara get a farming job on Chiho's recommendation. Emi seems to have some feelings about it.

title.value: Il Signore dei Demoni e l'Eroe fanno di tutto per proteggere la famiglia Sasaki

overview.value: Thieves and demons and bears, oh my!

title.value: Il Signore dei Demoni vuole a tutti i costi comprare un televisore

overview.value: Maou thirsts for a TV, Emi learns some shocking news, and Urushihara schools us all on how to be proper NEETs.

title.value: Il Signore dei Demoni predica le relazioni interpersonali

overview.value: Buying the Devil's TV is more exciting than anyone expected. Unrelatedly, Maou is wiser about human relationships than anyone expected.

title.value: Il Signore dei Demoni e l'Eroe affrontano il presente

overview.value: The whole gang prepares for their showdown with Raguel. But the fight has a lot of unexpected twists and turns, thanks to meddling from more than one immortal.

title.value: Il Signore dei Demoni torna al lavoro

overview.value: The Sasazuka MgRonald's remodeling is complete. New toilets! Better coffee machines! Maou and Ashiya's worries would be over, if it weren't for the girls' suspicious new habit.

title.value: Il Signore dei demoni e l'Eroe mettono in discussione la loro quotidianità

overview.value: The battle with Gabriel and Raguel is over, but the transition back into daily life isn't all smooth sailing.

title.value: Il Signore dei Demoni e l'Eroe fanno il primo passo verso un nuovo sogno

overview.value: Maou has been thinking about dreams ever since his conversation with Kisaki, and he knows exactly what to do next. Of course, whether he can get the necessary parties' buy-in on his dream is another matter...

title.value: Il Signore dei Demoni e l'Eroe vanno a comprare un futon

overview.value: Alas Ramus deserves a safe and comfy place to sleep! Emi and Maou go on a futon-shopping quest while Ashiya and Urushihara try to figure out what's going on with Suzuno.

title.value: L'Eroe se ne va per un po' di tempo

overview.value: Emi takes a trip to Ente Isla. Those left behind in Japan spend a lot of time arguing about whether or not they're worried.

title.value: Il Signore dei Demoni parte in ritardo

overview.value: Urushihara and Suzuno rush to Chiho's aid, but Maou lags behind thanks to his lack of magic and his confusing new acquaintances. Meanwhile, Ashiya has the toughest job of all: explaining all this to Rika.

title.value: L'eroe piange

overview.value: Who's holding Emi hostage? Why are so many humans, demons, and angels after Ashiya? Maou needs to find out all this and more, but first he needs a new source of power to defeat the invading army with.

title.value: L'Eroe si fa domande sulla sua città natale

overview.value: Emi is freshly struck by all the differences between Ente Isla and Japan. Then Alas Ramus reveals more about herself, causing Emi to reevaluate several things. Meanwhile, Maou is just trying to coexist with Acieth Alla without losing his mind.

title.value: Il Signore dei Demoni butta tutto fuori

overview.value: Maou and Suzuno make their way through Ente Isla's forests. Emi and Ashiya each learn what they've been brought to Efzahan for.

title.value: Il Signore dei Demoni perde la sua posizione

overview.value: Are we about to finally learn the landlady's secret?! Also, Ashiya takes control of the Malebranche while Maou struggles with his magic and Emi struggles with the stress of her position.

title.value: L'Eroe danza sul campo di battaglia

overview.value: Suzuno and Albert's plan hits a snag, but Emi and Ashiya's plans are going oddly well. The big questions of the day are: Can Maou merge with Acieth again? And does he have enough gas left in Powered Dullahan III?

title.value: Il Signore dei Demoni e l'Eroe assistono ai cambiamenti di Ente Isla

overview.value: At last, all the players are in place for the final battle in Efzahan. What happens next?
